speaker: Cold Start / Vale and Castle

lines.text: Wayline's finally dropped the distribution rig on the receiving apron. My fitters take it to the workshop, bring the pump station back and put shore power into the yard. You keep them breathing while they do it. Then you're done.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [brisk, businesslike] Wayline's finally dropped the distribution rig on the receiving apron. My fitters take it to the workshop, bring the pump station back and put shore power into the yard. You keep them breathing while they do it. Then you're done.

lines.text: Checkpoints on the south haul and the quarry road, manned by day hands from the camps down the valley. My own militia hold the inner line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [confident] Checkpoints on the south haul and the quarry road, manned by day hands from the camps down the valley. My own militia hold the inner line.

lines.text: Armed, paid, and a third of what you cost.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [a little defensive] Armed, paid, and a third of what you cost.

lines.text: Harlan's crew took this yard off your own people. They'll know what a checkpoint is worth.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [measured, pointed] Harlan's crew took this yard off your own people. They'll know what a checkpoint is worth.

lines.text: Harlan's past the quarry. Jory's watched for three days and they haven't come near.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [dismissive] Harlan's past the quarry. Jory's watched for three days and they haven't come near.

lines.text: Your techs said Harlan's crew were trying to wake Morrow's bay. Did anyone ask why?
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [curious, probing] Your techs said Harlan's crew were trying to wake Morrow's bay. Did anyone ask why?

lines.text: Teo thinks her builders could put guns up round the yard. Maybe they could. That bay's the most saleable thing I own outside the Colossus, and every hour those drones work is wear on it. I'm not burning it on guns I don't need.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [reluctant, firm] Teo thinks her builders could put guns up round the yard. Maybe they could. That bay's the most saleable thing I own outside the Colossus, and every hour those drones work is wear on it. I'm not burning it on guns I don't need.

lines.text: Your yard. Captain, we cover the rig and the pump, and when the lights come on we lift.
lines.speaker: CASTLE / COMPANY COMMAND
lines.synthesisText: [cool, letting it go] Your yard. Captain, we cover the rig and the pump, and when the lights come on we lift.

lines.text: Keep fire off my fitters. And if those checkpoints call for help, they're on my payroll. Cover them back to the inner line.
lines.speaker: TAMSIN VALE / BASIN RECLAMATION
lines.synthesisText: [practical, a touch of conscience] Keep fire off my fitters. And if those checkpoints call for help, they're on my payroll. Cover them back to the inner line.
